_readme: Registered dealer, fleet and auction partners.
A partner appears on the storefront only once `agreementAccepted` is true.
`verification` controls which trust badge their cars carry:
LISTED            — registered, agreement accepted, business not yet checked
PARTNER_VERIFIED  — business name, GSTIN and address verified by Motorbotz
MOTORBOTZ_INSPECTED and MOTORBOTZ_VERIFIED are per-vehicle, not per-dealer,
and are set from data/inventory/inspections.json after a physical inspection.
A dealer can never grant themselves either one.
`apiKey` is the bearer token for POST /api/dealer/inventory. Rotate from the
partner portal. In production this belongs in a secrets store, not in a file
